conditions.scenario: a media player with its playlist

summary: The page layout and dark theme styling are mostly coherent, but the context menu exhibits text formatting and alignment inconsistencies.

issues.title: Text spacing defects in menu labels
issues.description: Several context menu items display unintended spaces inside words.
issues.evidence: Labels render as 'Add to que ue', 'Downloade d', and 'Re move from playlist'.
issues.suggestion: Correct label strings to remove interior whitespace.

issues.title: Uneven item indentation
issues.description: The item without an icon lacks inset alignment with adjacent icon-bearing items.
issues.evidence: 'Downloaded' sits at an offset indentation compared to 'Add to playlist' and 'Add to queue'.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent padding or reserve an icon slot across all items.
